sentence: As of March 31, 2014, our global workforce totaled approximately 150,000 permanent employees.
As of June 30, 2017 , we employed a total of approximately 68,000 employees worldwide, excluding temporary employees and contractors.
As of October 29, 2016 , we employed approximately 10,000 individuals worldwide.
At the end of Fiscal 2017, we had approximately 138,000 total full-time employees, approximately 20,000 of which were employees of VMware.
As of December 31, 2021, Amkor employed 30,400 regular full-time employees, of whom approximately 97%, 2% and 1% resided in the Asia-Pacific region, Europe and North America, respectively.

As of the end of fiscal year 2024, we had approximately 29,600 employees in 36 countries, 22,200 were engaged in research and development and 7,400 were engaged in sales, marketing, operations, and administrative positions.
We operated 39 manufacturing locations in 16 countries, and employed 33,613 people worldwide as of June 30, 2011.
As of October 1, 2016 , we had approximately 45,397 employees, including approximately 10,439 temporary employees.
As of June 29, 2013 , we employed 9,019 persons.
As of September 27, 2014, the Company had approximately 92,600 full-time equivalent employees and an additional 4,400 full-time equivalent temporary employees and contractors.
As of December 31, 2011, we had approximately 53,600 employees worldwide, of which approximately 11,000 were employed by or working on behalf of VMware.
Our workforce consists of approximately 10,000 employees located around the world, more than 99% of whom are full-time employees.

As of June 30, 2010, we employed 1,012 full time employees and 24 consultants, consisting of 403 employees in research and development, 120 employees in sales and marketing, 97 employees in general and administrative and 392 employees in manufacturing.
As of September 30, 2017 , the Company had approximately 123,000 full-time equivalent employees.
As of June 30, 2013 , we had 4,162 employees, with 1,647 employed in the U.S., 1,493 in Mexico, 660 in Europe, and 362 in Asia.
